Download a complete ChecklistBank dataset as a ColDP archive

Source: R/save_clb.R
save_clb.Rd

Downloads the complete dataset selected by dataset from ChecklistBank and saves the ColDP ZIP archive under sacha_exports/checklistbank_<dataset> within directory. The archive includes its own metadata.yaml file. A neighbouring JSON file records the dataset key, download URL, response status, retrieval time, archive size and checksum.

save_clb(
  dataset = .sacha_global_config$dataset,
  directory = getwd(),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

Arguments

dataset

ChecklistBank dataset key or alias, supplied as a character string or a whole number. Defaults to the dataset currently configured by sacha_configure().

directory

Base directory under which sacha_exports is created for the archive and its download metadata. Defaults to the current working directory; the required directories are created when necessary.

overwrite

Logical; replace an existing archive and its metadata file. Defaults to TRUE.

Value

Invisibly, the normalized path to the downloaded ColDP ZIP archive.

Details

The default dataset is the one configured by sacha_configure(). Supply another ChecklistBank dataset key to download a different dataset without changing the package configuration.

ChecklistBank does not publish a general numeric request or bandwidth quota for this export endpoint. The function therefore keeps retries bounded: it makes at most three attempts for HTTP 429 and selected temporary server errors, follows a Retry-After delay up to five minutes, and otherwise waits 15 seconds and then 60 seconds. Longer server-requested delays stop the download so it can be retried later. Network and transfer errors are not retried because repeating a large archive transfer could add unnecessary load. If the API export route returns 404, the function also tries the ChecklistBank download route. Only a ZIP response is accepted; HTML pages and other responses are rejected with their HTTP status and content type.

References

ChecklistBank API guide: https://github.com/CatalogueOfLife/backend/blob/master/API.md. ChecklistBank dataset export endpoint: https://api.checklistbank.org/dataset/{key}/export.zip. Catalogue of Life Data Package (ColDP) specification: https://catalogueoflife.github.io/coldp/.

See also

sacha_configure()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
save_clb()
save_clb(dataset = "316441")
save_clb(dataset = 313479)
} # }
